title: Artifact envelope
description: Every kernel artifact record. content_id hashes the canonical payload bytes; artifact_id hashes the envelope (type, content_id, producer, inputs, subject) under a different domain separator, so identical content stored once still carries distinct provenance records. Payload shape is selected by `type`.

type.description: Contract type URI and semantic version, e.g. review.kernel/FindingReport@1.

input_artifacts.description: Exact artifact IDs consumed to produce this record. No ambient inputs.

subject_snapshot_id.description: The snapshot this artifact is a statement about. Absent only for artifacts that precede a snapshot.

producer.description: Tagged union. Reviewer and other executed output is `attempt` and carries its unique Attempt ID. Deterministic kernel-derived output is `kernel_operation` with a stable operation_id, so re-executing the same canonical operation reproduces the same artifact_id.

operation_id.description: Stable canonical operation identity, e.g. a reduction_batch_id or integration_batch_id.
